subject: Assurance re-attestation and proposed log-preservation path
messages:
From: Alex Jansen <alex.jansen@acme-analytics.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>; Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Assurance re-attestation & log-preservation request for renewal

Hi Priya / Ben,

As we prepare for our upcoming contract anniversary, our security/compliance team needs an updated assurance package to complete our procurement checklist. Specifically we're asking for: 

- A concise re-attestation statement covering SOC 2 scope changes in the last 12 months (if any)
- Confirmation of audit log retention window (we currently require 18 months for regulated pipelines)
- Representative access logs and rotation policy for KMS keys (redacted where appropriate)
- A manifest of where evidence will be staged (S3/Drive link) and an SLA for access during our audit window

Attached is our expectation checklist (acme-request-checklist.pdf) — hope this helps scope things. Can you confirm whether Redwood can extend log retention to 18 months or provide an export workflow we can rely on? Also: we have a compliance call Thursday 6/18; ideally the evidence handoff or a mock package would be available prior to that meeting.

Thanks,
Alex Jansen
Senior Security Manager
Acme Analytics

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jansen <alex.jansen@acme-analytics.com>; Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 11:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Assurance re-attestation & log-preservation request for renewal

Alex — thanks for the clear checklist and timeline. We're ready to support the 6/18 call and can provide a staged evidence package beforehand. Quick summary of proposed actions from Redwood:

1) Temporary evidence staging: we will assemble a mock handoff (redacted logs + manifest) to a read-only Drive folder by end of day Wed 6/17.
2) Retention options: we can enable a 18-month export pipeline (automated monthly snapshots) — this requires a short configuration change on your tenant and a 90-day run-in to backfill the window. If you need a retroactive full 18-month set immediately, we can provide an export job as a one-time activity (may take 48–72 hours depending on volume).
3) Re-attestation note: there have been no material scoped changes to our SOC 2 boundary since our last attestation; I'll draft a short re-attestation statement for your records.
4) Capacity note: if you plan to increase log ingestion/retention significantly we recommend a capacity uplift (reserved burst) to ensure retention exports do not impact throughput — Ben can detail options.

I've attached a draft evidence manifest (redwood-draft-evidence-manifest.csv) which lists the expected artifacts and access controls. Laura, can you confirm the export cadence and whether the export URLs will be S3 presigned or Drive links? Ben — do we have the uplift pricing grid for a short-term burst and for a three-month reserved window?

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Manager, Customer Security
Redwood Inference
---
Attachment: redwood-draft-evidence-manifest.csv (CSV stub: columns: artifact_name, path_or_link, retention_notes)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>; Alex Jansen <alex.jansen@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Assurance re-attestation & log-preservation request for renewal

Priya / Alex — quick price/term note from the commercial side.

- Short-term burst (48–72h export-heavy) — we can add a temporary dedicated bandwidth reservation for $2,500 (one-time) for the export job to ensure no throttling.
- 3-month reserved uplift (recommended if you plan to keep 18-month rolling retention at scale): $5,500/month — this includes monitoring, priority support during the audit window, and 99.9% export SLA.
- If Acme is willing to extend contract term by 6 months at current rates we can include the first month of reserved uplift at no charge (simple amendment).

Marta / Alex — happy to put this in a short amendment (DocuSign) once you confirm which path you want. Also looping legal/finance is straightforward — who at Acme should I send the DocuSign to?

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Jansen <alex.jansen@acme-analytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>; Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 16:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Assurance re-attestation & log-preservation request for renewal

Thanks — this is helpful.

We'd like to do the following:

- Proceed with the one-time export job immediately (we need the historical 18-month set for our auditor). Please schedule the export job as soon as you have capacity and confirm the expected completion time.
- For forward-looking retention, we'll accept the 3-month reserved uplift as a trial (send the amendment). Marta will own the DocuSign and procurement side for this.
- Please share the staged Drive folder link and the redacted sample logs before EOD Wed 6/17 so our compliance team can validate structure.

Marta, please advise who on procurement should receive the DocuSign (email + contact).
